name: Jenni AI
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Jenni AI, draft academic-style prose from uploaded sources while keeping citation provenance visible. The hard boundary is citation search, document workflow, and polished editor integrations, plus workflow, data, and model tuning.
